scope: Leave pressure responsive groups, disclosure of all returned groups, unchanged reported counts and existing day review.
confirmed_before: Chromium 320 baseline showed only eight unit groups, three nested panels and no day-review action in the pressure summary.
changes: Intrinsic responsive layout and tonal group surfaces replace nested panels; numeric counts use tabular figures.
First eight groups remain immediately visible; native disclosure exposes every remaining server-returned group in the original count order.
Approved/blocking and pending/review copy is explicitly scoped to this summary. Reported total and blocking counts, top-seven day ordering and underlying values remain unchanged.
Review day uses the existing day-modal event delegation, escaped labels and full-date accessible name. Empty returned pressure has a truthful message.

action_contracts.outcome: Eight initially visible groups expand to all twelve returned groups; exact keys/counts and HTML escaping asserted.
Existing exact-date modal shows Approved, Requested and Imported, Pending Review without extra requests. Escape returns focus to exact opener and retains expanded groups.

visual_review.result: Mobile dark summary wraps within the viewport with readable explanatory text, tonal groups and aligned counts.

limitations: GET-only pressure/calendar fixtures and disposable companion GETs. No actual backend aggregate consistency or leave mutation certification.
Three shown statuses asserted in existing day modal; cancelled/rejected status representations and all leave workflows remain separate acceptance.
Empty pressure is an empty aggregate response, not a claim that the independently supplied calendar contains no leave.
Tabular figures, nested-border cleanup and empty-state evidence cover this surface only. Full app token consistency and all actionable empty states remain unproven.
Physical devices, native assistive technology and new independent review pending. Broad 144-layout matrix remains historical.
No backend/API-contract/permission/scheduling/persisted-data/export-content/production changes in this batch. Full 260-item goal active and incomplete.
